snippet.title: Stargazer Game Trailer - Wishlist now!
snippet.description:
My first game is out now on Steam Store for wishlists, and will be released on the 27th of August this year for Windows and Mac!

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3120980/Stargazer/
